before.title: Chemoradiation for canine high-grade glioma
before.status: Participation currently possible on the University of Zurich study page
before.funding: The university states that biopsy, chemotherapy and study laboratory tests are covered and radiotherapy is discounted; confirm all costs directly.
before.notes: All enrolled dogs receive radiotherapy. Dogs are randomized to temozolomide plus lomustine or placebo to evaluate added chemotherapy for high-grade glioma.

after.title: Chemoradiation for canine high-grade glioma
after.status: Participation currently possible on the University of Zurich study page
after.funding: The university states that biopsy, chemotherapy and study laboratory tests are covered and radiotherapy is discounted; confirm all costs directly.
after.notes: All enrolled dogs receive radiotherapy. Dogs are randomized to temozolomide plus lomustine or placebo to evaluate added chemotherapy for high-grade glioma.
after.special_requirement: MRI-suspected high-grade glioma may enter screening. The study confirms the diagnosis with a minimally invasive tumor biopsy before treatment; biopsy costs are covered. All dogs receive ten radiation sessions and are randomized to temozolomide plus lomustine or placebo. Neurologic, organ-function, anesthesia and study-treatment suitability require Zurich assessment.

reason: The actual current official full brochure explicitly permits tentative MRI diagnosis followed by funded study biopsy before treatment. A universal pathology-confirmed-before-screening gate wrongly excluded this published route.
